notes: Account: mid-enterprise provider of B2B legal/regulatory search products; strong EU (London/Dublin) customer base.
Primary ask: low-latency, high-accuracy RAG pipeline: embeddings + reranker on 100M+ docs (expected 120-160M vectors after passageization).
Latency targets: p95 rerank end-to-end <120ms for UK users (goal <80ms for top-tier routes); search-only (no rerank) p95 <40ms in-region.
Throughput: baseline 150 QPS with ability to burst to 700 QPS during peak; indexing cadence nightly with delta updates every 10-15 minutes for high-priority sources.
Cost constraints: customer wants unit economics analysis. Target fully-burdened cost per query (embedding + rerank + retrieval) <= €0.0025; currently paying ~€0.006 on managed vendors.

Data residency: MUST store index shards and backups in UK for UK customers; EU (IE) copies allowed for pan-EU customers. Keeps PII in UK-only partitions. Legal team requested architecture diagram demonstrating no cross-border replica for UK-only segments.
Routing/failover: require multi-region active-passive routing (primary LON, failover DUB). Want automatic DNS or smart gateway failover with warm standby dedicated pool in the failover region.

Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models for embeddings (SBERT-like / open-embedding models) and a small re-ranker finetuned on their internal relevance labels. Interested in Redwood-curated model variants and quantization profiles to hit cost/latency targets.
Security: will require SSO/SAML for Console, KMS integration for key management, and per-request audit logs (30 month retention for legal audit). SOC2 + ISO27001 required contract clauses.

POC scope (agreed): 1) ingest 20M doc sample and validate vectorization speed 2) run 72-hour QPS soak to measure p95 latencies 3) validate reranker quality on 2k query test-set and latency impact 4) deliver cost projection for full 120M corpus.
